Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

If Amam has 1 life and is in combat with a Procurer with 1 life, and
they both strike hands, does Amam gain a life from his text before
burning himself? I think Amam burns (and is then shuffled into his
owner's library), because damage resolution resolves simultaneously
for both minions.

Thanks,
Ira

Name: Amam the Devourer (Bane Mummy)
[FN:R2]
Cardtype: Ally
Clan: Follower of Set
Cost: 2 pool
Unique mummy with 3 life. 0 bleed, 2 strength.
Amam may enter combat with any ready minion controlled by another
Methuselah as a (D) action. Amam may burn a vampire in torpor to gain
1 life as a (D) action. This does not constitute diablerie. If a
minion opposing Amam in combat is burned, Amam gains 1 life. If Amam
is burned, shuffle him into his owner's library.
